fitment:
2014-2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab
2014-2018 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab

description:
YITAMOTOR provides you with the best innovative, quality products & professional services at competitive prices. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2014-2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab
2014-2018 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab
Fits carpet flooring, for non-flow-through console, no shifter, no PTO kit, and models with 1st-row bench seats.
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Compatibility: Custom fit for Chevrolet Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra 1500 Crew Cab 2014-2018, Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra 2500HD 3500HD Crew Cab 2015-2019. ONLY for crew cab with 1st row bench seat and carpeted floor. NOT for Silverado EV, Sierra EV and vehicles with vinyl floors, flow-through console, or manual 4x4 shifter. State-of-the-art 3D laser scanning technology gives the front and back rows floorboard edge to edge protection.
Sturdy & Non-slip: Made from odorless high-density thickened TPE rubber, these specifically tailored Silverado / Sierra 1500 2500HD 3500HD crew cab bench seat floor liners are of great touch feeling and extreme wear-resistance. These mats for Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra contain no latex, cadmium, lead, or harmful PVC, and the non-slip design makes them stay in place firmly for safe driving experience.
All Weather Protection: Our 2014-2018 Chevrolet Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500, 2015-2019 2500HD/3500HD Crew Cab floor mats come with anti-slip retainer clips, and textured surface that helps keep the liners from shifting, flexible even in harsh cold or hot weather. The raised edge and deep ribs can effectively trap liquids, debris, snow, mud, sand, and other elements to render full protection all year around.
Easy Maintenance: Installation & cleaning for these Silverado/Sierra accessories is a breeze. Simply remove the old mats, then place and snug our new floor liners. Shake off or hose down the mess to achieve a pristine look after long time use, no need for vacuuming or harsh chemicals. The maintenance are easy to be done in minutes.
Why Choose Us: YITAMOTOR floor mats are engineered with advanced technology for tailored protection; The dedicated US-based teams deliver the floor liners of all-weather guard and built-to-last quality.
